items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I‘m the oldest one. Ernie is the big one. I‘m the oldest, Ernie is next, and Dale is the next Horn.

ctx.x: And in what order are you all?
I‘m the oldest one. Ernie is the big one. I‘m the oldest, Ernie is next, and Dale is the next Horn. Yes, he‘s the baby.
